summary.text: Saint Basil the Great’s mother, whose family included Saint Gregory of Nyssa, Saint Macrina the Younger, and Saint Peter of Sebaste.

blocks.text: Emilia was a martyr’s daughter and the wife of Basil, a Caesarean lawyer and teacher of rhetoric. The OCA records ten children in their household.
blocks.reason: A concise source-bound account of the saint's life, identity and death; the linked modern source is not reproduced in full.

blocks.text: Emilia taught Scripture and joined her daughter’s monastic community.
